_metadata.description: Binary brand-asset storage (logos, favicons, derived icon variants, transparent cutouts) on the filesystem, tracked by metadata rows in SQLite. Upsert-by-(brand_id, filename): exploratory AI generations land under unique filenames (preserved, never clobbered) while canonical/derived assets use stable names.

requirements.title: Store brand asset files under a per-brand directory
requirements.description: Uploaded or generated brand assets are written to ~/.vrooli/brand-manager/assets/{brand_id}/ and represented by an assets metadata row referencing the file path, kind, and content type.

validation.notes: Planned unit coverage at api/internal/assets/store_test.go once asset storage is ported.

requirements.title: Asset writes are atomic and do not corrupt on failure
requirements.description: Asset files are written via a temp-file-then-rename so an interrupted write never leaves a partially-written asset at the canonical path.

validation.notes: Planned unit coverage at api/internal/assets/atomic_test.go once atomic asset writes are ported.
